items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Anyway, then with Stanley and them went to Hollywood.

ctx.x: It wasn’t like paradiddles or working some sound, all you had to do was take the stick and (imitates roll). Does Art Blakey need to come in and smack
you? Anyway, then with Stanley and them went to Hollywood. They were selling jazz thing it was a bad name, you know?
